# Synthetic adapter examples

All records are invented test data, not SWaT measurements. Network JSONL contains already normalized synthetic adapter records, not raw packet decoding. Its synthetic protocol and operations make no CIP coverage claim. Process CSV deliberately contains a multiline field, zero, a missing value and a nonfinite value. Profile: `profiles/synthetic-demo.json`.

These two inputs are independent demonstrations: no clock alignment, device matching, causal link, attack label or gold annotation is supplied. Shared example timestamps do not establish real cross-source correspondence.
